about: Invented people and things; English and Spanish. Every story is one held mention ('Nick', 'Mara', 'Atlas') with one or two conversations. `expect`: 'file:<page id>' when the conversation itself says which one and the record can tie it, 'left' for the rest. `by` for a 'left': 'code' when the code conditions alone must refuse it whatever a reader says, 'reader' when only a careful reader refuses it.
